views.name: study-start
views.title: The study: en garde in the daylight room
views.caption: five quiet seconds to judge the look by: the opponent at their line, your bell low on the right, the windows' light on the floor

views.name: study-closer
views.title: One step closer
views.caption: the same moment a step later: how much nearer they are, read off their size, the piste's lines and the window light sliding under them

views.name: study-rolled
views.title: Your hand rolled
views.caption: the wrist turned a little: the blade's faces take the window differently, the bell (mounted off-centre) shifts, the glove turns

views.name: menu
views.title: Learn, or fence
views.caption: seven lessons in the order a beginner learns them; four opponents, each allowing less bullet time

views.name: brief
views.title: A lesson’s brief
views.caption: what the master says before the first repetition

views.name: lesson
views.title: A lesson under way
views.caption: the coach about to attack on your inside line; the count of good repetitions at full speed, and the pace

views.name: verdict
views.title: The verdict
views.caption: the judge reads the bout: here, no parry at all, and what to do instead

views.name: replay
views.title: The touch again
views.caption: after each touch, the last second again, slowing into the hit, from the side, with what happened written as it happens

views.name: mask
views.title: En garde, through the mask
views.caption: at the lines, before allez: their point toward you, your own bell low on the right

views.name: close
views.title: In distance
views.caption: a riposte coming: their bell turned toward your blade, your blade crossing theirs

views.name: wrist
views.title: Touched on the arm
views.caption: your bell covered your chest, so they went for what it didn't: your arm. Their lamp is lit

views.name: double
views.title: A touch, from the side
views.caption: the lunge home, the blade bowed against the chest, your lamp lit; the clock under the score

views.name: readout
views.title: What the box hears
views.caption: the readout: the gap, each tip's force against its 7.35 N, how far each blade is bowed, how hard each hand is working, what the opponent is doing
